title: A 32-year-old bug walks into a Telnet server
summary: Watchtowr Labs researchers discovered a 32-year-old remote code execution vulnerability in GNU inetutils telnetd (CVE-2026-32746), demonstrating that even decades-old legacy software can contain critical security flaws that remain undiscovered for extended periods.
problem_solved: Reveals and documents a critical remote code execution vulnerability that has existed in GNU inetutils telnetd since approximately 1992.
why_valuable: Highlights the ongoing risks of unexamined legacy code and demonstrates that fundamental vulnerabilities can persist undetected for decades, even in widely-deployed open source software components.
